title: S4-NEW-11 — A swatch knows which pot.
goal: Colors edits the pot it was opened from: a swatch chosen from the Primary well changes only the primary color, one chosen from the Secondary well changes only the secondary; the artwork never changes.

steps.why: The Primary pot took the swatch.
The Secondary pot took the second swatch.
The Primary pot kept its own color.

cliOnly: Shift-click and right-click on a swatch, which need held modifiers or a pointer right-click (tests/production/inputOwnership.spec.ts, tests/production/canvasContextMenu.spec.ts)
